**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The governing law and venue provisions sit in the General Provisions block (§ (a) GOVERNING LAW, p0145–p0147):

- **Governing law:** internal laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict of law principles.
- **Venue:** suits must be instituted in the City of New York, with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the S.D.N.Y. or any New York State court, plus waivers of venue objections and forum non conveniens.
- **Arbitration:** none — a document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no offshore-seat risk.

This meets the preferred position (New York law, exclusive New York state and federal courts). The only variance is "City of New York" rather than "New York County," which is immaterial and noted in the rationale rather than flagged.
